faq.q: Is eCola in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Yes. eCola returns in GTA 6, placed on signage and vending machines around Vice City, next to its rival Sprunk, according to press coverage of the trailers.

faq.q: What is eCola's rivalry with Sprunk?
faq.a: eCola has been the in-universe rival to Sprunk since Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in 2002, with a pairing that mirrors the real Coca-Cola and Pepsi rivalry, red branding included.

faq.q: Is eCola based on a real soda brand?
faq.a: eCola's rivalry with Sprunk mirrors the real Coca-Cola versus Pepsi rivalry, and the record lists Pepsi as its real-world basis.

faq.q: Can players buy eCola in GTA 6?
faq.a: Do not expect a mission, a shop, or anything interactive. None has been shown, so eCola is currently only confirmed on machines, billboards, and shop fronts.

faq.q: How was eCola confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: Press coverage placed eCola on signage and vending machines in trailer footage, which is identification of background art rather than a direct Rockstar statement.
